fact: A DGDDL workshop on 31 July-1 August 2025, supported by Expertise France (financed by the French Treasury), reviewed draft interministerial orders on approvals for electronic collection of local revenue, with pilot communes Anyama, Cocody and Tiassalé.
title: Mobilisation des recettes propres des Collectivités: La digitalisation arrive pour freiner les pertes et les fraudes
